rules.scope: suppress a generic value/values field obligation when the token is an adjacent nominal head of another explicitly grounded field
rules.rationale: An exact schema-name match is evidence, not proof of an independent field reference; local syntax must distinguish 'profit values' from 'profit and value'.
rules.failure_condition: A generic value field survives as an independent obligation despite an adjacent grounded measure with no coordination cue.
rules.conflict_policy: Preserve the generic field candidate for audit, remove only its required obligation; explicit standalone or coordinated mentions remain required.

rules.scope: compile an explicit rank/ranking directive into a ranking analytical goal when dimension and measure roles are structurally complete
rules.rationale: Ranking is an analytical goal, whereas sorting is its execution operation; an explicit ranking directive must not fall back to generic comparison.
rules.failure_condition: An executable explicit ranking request is selected as comparison, or ranking is forced without both measure and dimension roles.
rules.conflict_policy: Explicit structurally complete ranking outranks comparison; incomplete ranking remains unresolved or is handled by existing safe ambiguity logic.
